reason: The pure core (planCapacity/budgetGate) already takes consumedPoints as a parameter; the only missing piece is a meter that turns timestamped usage samples into per-window consumedPoints (rolling sum vs calendar-boundary reset) and a budget-check.ts wiring that reads those samples.
